Maya: Quick weekly check-in for Sentinel onboarding — attaching the p95/p99 latency split by route + model and streaming vs non-streaming. TL;DR: streaming wins p95 on short prompts for small models but p99 tail regresses on longer-context routes; overall error-rate up ~0.2% on streaming for /summarize route. Spend is +12% week-over-week because of higher token churn from retry/resyncs.

Liam: can you drop the raw numbers? want to forward to product for the roadmap sync.

Maya: sure — pasted small table below (numbers in ms, p95 / p99). these are aggregated over last 7 days for production traffic.

Maya: ```
route,model,mode,p95_ms,p99_ms,error_rate_percent,requests
/summarize/gpt-small,redwood-gpt-small,streaming,120,410,0.78,18_400
/summarize/gpt-small,redwood-gpt-small,non-streaming,155,320,0.56,22_100
/chat/gpt-encoder,redwood-chat-medium,streaming,95,680,0.22,9_300
/chat/gpt-encoder,redwood-chat-medium,non-streaming,140,360,0.18,9_900
/qa/longcontext,redwood-large,streaming,310,2300,0.91,3_200
/qa/longcontext,redwood-large,non-streaming,420,1900,0.67,3_400
```

Olivia: thanks — so for /summarize streaming has lower p95 but p99 is higher for small model. do we know what is causing the p99 tail on streaming? network retries or model stalls?

Maya: quick theory: streaming path triggers more prefix cache hits which reduces p95, but longer-lived connections occasionally hit a kernel stall when context > 8k tokens; we also saw a bump in 502/504s in logs that line up with spikes.

SRE Bot: ALERT: regressed_latency_threshold crossed for route=/qa/longcontext mode=streaming p99 increased by 21% vs baseline (last 14d) — ticket #CS-1487 created.

Ezra: putting on my SRE hat — immediate mitigations: 1) enable per-request max-chunk-size to 512 for longcontext streaming to reduce KV pressure; 2) temporary canary to non-streaming for 20% of traffic on /qa/longcontext for next 48h; 3) add a retry budget so clients back off instead of aggressive resends.

Liam: +1 to canary. can we quantify expected spend delta if we move 20% of that route to non-streaming?

Maya: estimate: /qa/longcontext is ~3.2k reqs/day, moving 20% reduces streaming-specific retries -> roughly +0.6% net spend change for account, but should drop p99 by ~30% in canary shard. full numbers in the ticket.

Olivia: for enablement: I'll draft a short note for the customer with the recommended temporary canary + why latency improved on p95 but p99 regressed. want to set expectations re: cost/sla tradeoffs. any objections?

Ezra: no objections. I'll prep the canary rollout plan and a quick rollback command set for oncall.

Maya: owners: Ezra (canary rollout + metrics), Olivia (customer comms), Liam (product sync + decision), me (follow-up data & post-mortem). I'll update CS-1487 with action items.

Liam: thanks — include a simple chart comparing week-over-week p95/p99 in the ticket, that helps product.

Maya: noted. will attach chart & raw csv by EOD tomorrow. :calendar:

Olivia: I'll coordinate a 15-min customer huddle after the canary has 6 hours of data.

SRE Bot: NOTE: CS-1487 assigned to Ezra, priority=P1.

Maya: closing loop — we want to avoid large config changes mid-onboard; temporary canary + throttles is the least risky path. will update once canary is live. :thumbsup:
